svg.aria-label: The manuscript mode of the researcher skill. Boxes: The record of the experiments, when the project holds none (stop); You confirm the run's configuration and its budget (stop); /paper full: the draft, Stage 2 (a run of another skill); The checkpoint after Stage 2 (stop); Integrity agent, Stage 2.5: the sampled depth, the ethics check last (agent); Compliance agent, Stage 2.5 (agent); A failure-mode block, a compliance block, or a BLOCKED or CONDITIONAL ethics verdict (stop); A FAIL: the correction list to confirm (stop); /paper revision: the correction round (a run of another skill); The third correction round failed: you decide (stop); The checkpoint after Stage 2.5 (stop); /paper-review-panel full: the review, Stage 3 (a run of another skill); The review decision (stop); /paper revision: the revision, Stage 4 (a run of another skill); The checkpoint after Stage 4 (stop); /paper-review-panel re-review: the re-review, Stage 3' (a run of another skill); A regression, or the early-stopping suggestion, from the score deltas (stop); The re-review decision (stop); /paper revision: the minor items of a Minor decision, once (a run of another skill); /paper revision: the re-revision, Stage 4', once (a run of another skill); The checkpoint after Stage 4' (stop); A fresh integrity agent, Stage 4.5: the full depth, the ethics check last (agent); Compliance agent, Stage 4.5 (agent); A failure-mode block, a compliance block, or a BLOCKED or CONDITIONAL ethics verdict (stop); A FAIL: the correction list to confirm (stop); /paper revision: the correction round (a run of another skill); The third correction round failed: you decide (stop); The checkpoint after Stage 4.5 (stop).
